Mental Health check in from Seattle over by my @Seahawks training camp stop…

PRACTICE BEING PROUD!!!

My self talk is all often wayyyyy too negative. The roommates in my head are constantly telling me the worst things about myself. 

But instead of just letting them run rampant I started doing something to fight back against them. Every morning I now turn on a song and for the duration meditate by telling myself things I’m PROUD of about me. Over and over and over. That’s hard for a lot of us. 

Hard to the point I had to actually write a list on my phone so I can go back to them when my brain wants to go negative and start beating up on me again. 

The battle is on-going but I’ve had way more mornings now where I start the day kicking the gray’s ass instead of the other way around.

Hope this helps. Let’s keep walking this walk together. Love y’all

#mentalhealth #anxiety #depression #unbreakable
